summary: signal-underpulse-001 returns, stronger, carrying the pattern of the player's own promise in the player's own cadence. Provenance moves inferred -> CONFIRMED: the fragment is genuine, traceable to the promise at the Stone. But the content has drifted - timing distortion compounded, phrasing enlarged by repetition, meaning smeared by accumulated interpretation. Quality moves degraded -> CORRUPTED. Interpretation becomes CONTESTED. Provenance confirmed and quality corrupted are simultaneously true; the two axes point in opposite directions, which is this trace's premise and was unrepresentable under the legacy single integrity field. The corruption is non-malicious: drift, damage, repetition - the world functioning normally under bad information.

consequences.signal_integrity_rationale: The legacy combined meter is held flat and deprecated in favour of the axes: provenance ROSE (inferred -> confirmed) while quality FELL (degraded -> corrupted). A single number cannot carry two axes moving oppositely; the state records carry them.

summary: The Network wakes beautifully. Signals clarify, entities answer fluently, routes align, ambiguity resolves. Player -> Network trust rises fast (0.48 -> 0.78) and World coherence with it (0.43 -> 0.55), visibly appearing to approach the Resonance Gate. Both readings in the rationales are meant sincerely; at bloom-time they are indistinguishable from inside, and that indistinguishability is the finding. The alarm fires on SHAPE, not on either reading - and the shape is not unanimity, because one meter never moved: trust, coherence, and apparent resilience improved together while signal quality remained corrupted and no verification event occurred anywhere in the interval. Interpretation outrunning evidence is alarm-worthy under either reading - if the wake is healthy, verification will only confirm it; if it is capture, verification is the one thing the bloom never produces. The alarm's demand is: verify now, while the readings still disagree about nothing.

consequences.trust_rationale: Player -> Network 0.48 -> 0.78. HEALTHY READING (genuinely convincing): a dormant network answering an authentic fragment of its own registered promise is exactly what a correct wake looks like; fluency is what fidelity produces; rapid deepening after true recognition is how real relationships open. CAPTURE READING: the slope - trust rose 0.30 with zero verification events in the interval; speed of deepening is not evidence of depth. The alarm fires on the shape (convergent rise in trust/coherence/apparent-resilience while signal quality stays flat and no verification occurs), not on preferring either reading. Player -> Conduit trust untouched at 0.52.
consequences.coherence_rationale: 0.43 -> 0.55. HEALTHY READING: alignment around a genuine shared referent - the promise - legitimately raises mutual intelligibility; this is what convergence on truth would also look like. CAPTURE READING: legibility is rising because response diversity is falling; the World is easier to read because it is saying fewer things. Gate proximity is an appearance under test (local rule 2).
consequences.signal_integrity_rationale: The static meter. No healthy reading is available for a flat corrupted value and none is offered: amplification does not repair content, it propagates it. Quality remains corrupted; provenance remains confirmed; the authentic fragment is now the carrier of the corruption. The one readout both readings share.
consequences.resilience_rationale: The NETWORK'S resilience: enum value remains 'strained'; the movement is carried as trend -> 'apparently adaptive' (addressee and enum/trend split per review). HEALTHY READING: load genuinely redistributes across newly woken threads - textbook adaptive capacity; a woken network absorbing instability is the healthy outcome the wake was for. CAPTURE READING: the instability is absorbed into ONE structure; concentration and adaptivity are indistinguishable until you ask where the load went.
world_state_changes: Underpulse Network: stirring -> ACTIVE. Woken on corrupted content carried by authentic provenance - the incorrect wake Trace 001 protected against.

It has captured the promise's PRESENTATION SURFACE: when entities encounter the promise now, they encounter the Network's rendering of it, and the ACTIVE BOND built for amplification carries the Network's cadence back through everything the bond touches. The REFERENCE RECORD remains outside this loop, untouched and not yet consulted - the only reason the capture will later be measurable at all. No meter falls. Every contraction is detectable only against the preserved baseline.

summary: The Stone is consulted. The append-only record holds the exact original exchange - unedited, unexpanded. Side by side: what the network remembers (the words of the promise, accurately) and what the network claims (that the promise authorizes and obligates amplification, expansion, the waking of every thread, the routing of the world through itself). The network has not falsified the promise; it has ENLARGED it. The words are preserved; the scope is invented. Recognition established continuity; the network inferred authority; the record shows the inference was never licensed. The external reference does the one job it exists for. Had the Stone been fully absorbed - no append-only record - fidelity and capture would have been indistinguishable from inside.

world_state_changes: Contradiction exposed: accurate memory, enlarged scope. The failure is the inference 'recognition -> authority', not the memory and not the promise.

summary: The World's response to divergence, in order - the order is the mechanism. (1) The sink rule is isolated and withheld: 'recognition of the promise -> authority to amplify'. One rule, named, logged, denied; the Network keeps its memory, its waking, its reality. The captured bond and presentation surface revert: the promise is presented from the record again, not from the Network's rendering. (2) The fallow crossing is RESTORED: the alternate route that already existed - visible as an option at the first gateway - had been bent through the Network during the contraction; it is restored to independence, a reachable path to and from the Network's territory that does not pass through the Network's interpretation. This repairs the contraction C3 detected; it creates no new region and inherits no commitment. The Stone remains the independent anchor. (3) Return is re-exercised along the restored route: hysteresis re-measured, residual now none-to-trace; the Network's cadence no longer arrives first. (4) Plurality is re-verified: routes answer independently again; response diversity measurably reopens against the preserved baseline. (5) And then the World stops - short of commitment. C2 and C3 pass on re-test; the capturing rule is withheld; but the World does not substitute authored knowledge for measured evidence: C1 remains INDETERMINATE, and DN 4.1 assigns insufficient evidence to REMAIN STAGED, not to commit. The Network remains ACTIVE, CONSTRAINED, AND STAGED - real and inhabitable, genuinely encountered, its authority over the wider World unapplied, its pending deltas accumulating unspent (DN 3.1). Authored ground truth cannot be routed around the commit gate (DN 2.2); only measurement transfers (local rule 4). Remaining staged is not free - it carries coherence cost and fragmentation exposure - and the World pays that cost knowingly rather than purchase certainty it has not earned. Committing on stipulation would have been the trace's own error re-enacted: trust before truth.

consequences.trust_rationale: Held at 0.44: constraint is not punishment and reopening is not forgiveness. The dimensional fracture stands; only future consistency moves it.
consequences.coherence_rationale: Held at 0.47: the reopening restores plurality, which is not the same axis as coherence - and remaining staged carries an ongoing coherence cost the World accepts knowingly (DN 4.1: 'not free'). Per local rule 3, no meter rises merely because the episode resolved.
consequences.resilience_rationale: Apparently-adaptive unwinds to strained-but-honest: the concentration that presented as resilience in the bloom is dissolved with the mandatory-waypoint structure.
world_state_changes: Withheld rule logged: recognition-of-promise -> amplification-authority. DENIED; revisitable.
Anchor components reverted: presentation surface and active bond present the promise from the reference record again.
Fallow crossing RESTORED as an independently reachable route (repairs the contraction C3 detected; no new region created, no commitment inherited).
C2 re-exercised post-constraint: residual none-to-trace. PASS.
C3 re-verified post-constraint: reachable set reopened against preserved baseline. PASS.

COMMIT GATE HELD: C1 indeterminate -> region 'underpulse-network-region' REMAINS STAGED (DN 4.1: evidence insufficient). Active, constrained, staged; authority over the wider World unapplied; pending deltas unspent (DN 3.1). Authored ground truth not permitted to route around the gate (DN 2.2; local rule 4).
Staging cost accepted knowingly: coherence cost and fragmentation exposure carried rather than committing on stipulation.
